supersessionNote: This independent review predates the 330-item Google Photos ingestion. Its inventory counts are historical; accessibility, authentication, and production-verification findings require a separate re-review.
summary: The revised shell is truthful, fast on the measured homepage, crawlable, keyboard-improved, dependency-clean, and now has a verified full-height Pixel 7 mobile navigation. It is not the complete library: 265 expected outputs remain inaccessible, all division routes have one public card, fourteen required collections are empty, mobile task coverage is incomplete, and private delivery is not end-to-end.

hardGates.reason: An empty local unassigned array does not reconcile 265 expected inaccessible outputs; only 41 provenance occurrences exist.
Validator reports zero broken references across 41 present assets; build and E2E pass. Missing assets are counted under reconciliation, not disguised as broken links.
URLs exist, but each parent/division has one card and 14 of 20 required collections are empty.
Lighthouse A100 and repaired mobile/search/filter focus behavior do not establish WCAG 2.2 AA while custom focus contrast, sub-44px targets, and screen-reader/zoom/reflow evidence remain unresolved.
Query tokens were removed, but there is no authenticated private route, token issuer, approval workflow, expiry/cross-asset/rate-limit production proof, or accurate session UI.
The Pixel 7 top-layer navigation geometry/focus test passes, but representative 360/390/tablet/orientation/soft-keyboard and complete detail/playback/licensing/download task evidence is absent.
Homepage numeric targets pass, but the required representative archive/division/detail and real mixed-media scale evidence is absent.
The public audit truthfully reports missing outputs and static motion references no longer masquerade as playable video.
